[[Moruth Doole]]'s '''defense fleet''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] formed by Doole to defend his [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mining operation on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].

==History==
After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was driven out of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], [[Moruth Doole]] seized control of the [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] mining operation there and placed his highest priority on creating a defensive fleet to protect Kessel from the Empire, [[Pirate/Legends|space pirates]], or any other criminal faction that might want control of the mines.<ref name="Jedi Search" /> He purchased every [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that he could find, no matter what the condition and hired experienced mechanics from the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to fix them. He also hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to fly the ships. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] would later speculate that this was one of the reasons why the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had trouble gaining sufficient numbers of fighting ships during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="Jedi Search" />

By [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the fleet consisted of hundreds of ships, based on Kessel's [[Garrison Moon]], with the larger [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] kept in orbit around the [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="Jedi Search" /> Despite their worn and battered appearances, the ships were actually well maintained and refitted to a high quality. During that year, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] flew to Kessel in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] on a diplomatic mission for the New Republic, but on their arrival in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], they were attacked by the fleet and shot down on the surface of Kessel. The ''Falcon'' was recovered, repaired and pressed into service with the fleet.

Han, Chewbacca, and [[Kyp Durron]] later escaped from Kessel and were attacked by the mercenary fleet, which forced them to fly on a course through the [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw Cluster]].<ref name="Jedi Search" /> [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and Luke Skywalker came to Kessel soon after to discover what had happened to Han and Chewbacca and they seized control of the ''Falcon'' and blasted off in it. Doole was determined that they wouldn't make it back to the New Republic, so he ordered the entire Kessel fleet to launch in pursuit of it, despite the tactical problems associated with this. However, as they pursued the ''Falcon'' in the direction of the Maw Cluster, the [[Sun Crusher]] and three [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] that were chasing it emerged. The Kessel mercenaries ran headlong into them and some peeled sideways to escape, while others panicked and opened fire. Daala speculated that the fleet could be a trap set for her by the New Republic and ordered the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to return fire, beginning a [[Skirmish in the Maw|battle]]. The Kessel fleet managed to inflict minor casualties on the Imperials, damaging the [[Basilisk (Star Destroyer)|''Basilisk'']] and destroying three [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] squadrons. However, it was hopelessly outmatched and the majority of the mercenary ships were soon destroyed.<ref name="Dark Apprentice">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref><ref name="CotF">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref> The few surviving pilots took their ships and fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], going their separate ways.<ref name="CotF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doole's Defense Fleet was created by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and featured in his [[Star Wars: The Jedi Academy Trilogy]], with an appearance in ''[[Jedi Search]]'' and mentions in [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']] and ''[[Champions of the Force]]''.

There is a minor variance in how much of the fleet was said to have been destroyed during the Fourth Battle of Kessel. In [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kratas]] says that two-thirds was destroyed, but in ''Champions of the Force'', [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] claims that it was ninety percent.
